messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock access, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
On July 6, 2026 New York City is on Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4). If you know the current UTC time, just subtract four hours to get the local time.  

For the most accurate result, check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart assistant that can read the current time.

Today is July 6, 2026. Daylight saving is in effect (DST starts second Sunday in March, ends first Sunday in November). So offset is UTC-4. Current UTC time? We don't know. We can approximate by using system time? We can't. We can say "I don't have real-time data" and suggest checking a reliable source. But maybe we can approximate by using the current time from the system? The assistant might not have that.
